First draft is up in Goal Canvas.dc.html, out for your review.

What's there

Canvas — Experimental 20% / Past 10% / Current 70% treemap; goals sized by source count; ⌘/pinch-scroll zooms (semantic: source titles appear past ~1.15×), scroll pans; click or zoom past a goal opens it with the zoom-and-fade transition. Esc or the crumbs zoom back out.
Sidebar — Topics 1–2 done, 3 in progress (dashed), 4 selected. Hover reveals context, click pins it, ⌃/› toggles; Workspace row first, then repo · pdf · dataset, then + Note. Free notes below. Drag the edge to resize.
Editor — **bold**, *italic*, [link](url), ⌘B/I/K; - starts a todo, Tab nests; Build / Build all use the goal-page's exact styling and lifecycle (Building… → Checking… → Done); @ mentions with hover preview cards. Sidebar notes open as tabs, ⌘1–9 switches.
Right pane — Live preview (interactive HypoCompass mock: test suite, Bob/Chelsea/Dave queue, chat), terminal with claude/codex switch, Paper (arXiv PDF) and Dataset modes.

Left underspecified, flagged rather than filled

Topic/goal/note names are literal ("Topic 4", "Goal 1", "Note 1"); goals other than Goal 1 open an empty shell.
Generic goals show italic "untitled …" source placeholders.
HypoCompass problem (second_largest) and the three buggy solutions are my sample, not from the repo.
The active line shows raw markdown (Obsidian live-preview style); it renders once you leave the line.
Terminal echoes only — no shell attached.
